_comment: Stroke of Genius AT THE OPPONENT decks them this turn (AccomplishedAlchemist chunk B, 2026-10-18).
Opponent library: 4. Seven mana (5 Forest + the turn's drawn-and-played Forest + Accomplished Alchemist, whose one any-colour mana is the
only BLUE source) pays {X}{2}{U} at exactly X = 4 = their library, the minimal lethal X
(opponentdeck::ForcedDrawLethalX). ForcedDraw empties the library and sets opponent_decked at
resolution, so the win is THIS turn (4) -- their end-of-turn draw would find nothing either way.
Guards three things at once: (1) the DrawX X-variant enumeration exists at all (before chunk B every
hand-cast {X} draw spell was dropped from enumeration); (2) the target player is searched and the
opponent variant reaches the executor as an OPPONENT target (AIEngine Targeting::Player from the
draw_target rider -> ResolveDrawX -> PerformDrawX); (3) the exact payer funds {U} + X off the
Alchemist's single-colour burst. No other clock exists: opponent life 20, nothing that deals damage.
